question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
SELECT team, SUM(wins) as total_wins
FROM (
    SELECT home_team as team, SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM match_view
    GROUP BY home_team
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team as team, SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM match_view
    GROUP BY away_team
) team_wins
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10

<tool_call>

SELECT 
    team,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 
        WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 0 
        ELSE 0 
    END + 
     CASE 
        WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 
        WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 0 
        ELSE 0 
    END) / 2.0 AS wins
FROM match_view
WHERE home_team IS NOT NULL AND away_team IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 10
